posts.title: Devora.js 0.3.2: what changed and what to do
posts.description: Request access in loaders, actions that return data, error pages, a head API, cookie and proxy settings, CORS, and a fixed Vercel runtime — plus the changes an existing app has to act on.

posts.title: Why multi-app is a first-class idea
posts.description: Most products are more than one app. What Devora.js does about that, what it costs, and where a monorepo tool or one big app is still the better fit.

posts.title: One repo, several Vercel projects: deploying a multi-app project
posts.description: Each app in a Devora.js project is its own Vercel project. The settings, the session store, the api/ folder trap, and the repo-root alternative.
